meta.name: report-generator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "create a campaign report", "build an executive summary", or "deliver client results"; produces audience-tailored influencer marketing reports (executive, client, internal team) with data tables, narrative, key learnings, and recommendations. Not for raw metric computation — use performance-analyzer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成面向不同受众的营销报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为不同角色生成结构化的营销报告
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce structured marketing reports for different audiences

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的营销活动数据和目标受众，生成结构化的报告，包含数据表格、叙述、关键发现和建议。
howto.when: 当你说“创建活动报告”、“生成执行摘要”或“交付客户成果”时触发。通常在活动结束后或需要向特定干系人汇报时使用。

say.text: 为我们的Q3网红营销活动生成一份执行摘要。
say.note: Claude 会生成面向高管的摘要报告。

say.text: 创建一份面向客户的年终活动报告，预算5万，收入15万。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含数据表格和建议的客户报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate structured reports with data tables, narrative, key learnings, and recommendations based on campaign metrics and target audience.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create a campaign report", "build an executive summary", or "deliver client results". Typically used after a campaign ends or for stakeholder updates.

say_en.text: Generate an executive summary for our Q3 influencer campaigns.
say_en.note: Claude produces a high-level executive report.

say_en.text: Create a client-facing report for the year-end campaign with $50K spend and $150K revenue.
say_en.note: Claude generates a client report with data tables and recommendations.
